chunks: And with this chain of transmission, from ʿAbd Allah ibn Bukayr, from Ṣāliḥ ibn Sayābah, from al-Ḥasan ibn Abī Sārah, who said:

I said to Abū ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام: We mix with the Jews, the Christians, and the Magians, and we enter upon them while they are eating and drinking, and their cupbearer passes by and pours wine onto my clothes. He said: There is no problem with it, unless you wish to wash it.

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no problem with it

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if wine spills onto clothing?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling concerning wine falling onto one's clothing during social interaction with non-Muslim communities. Imam Abū ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام states that there is no harm in it, though washing it is left to personal preference.
